text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a multi-day business trip scheduled, 
I gave Fusaichi Pandora her independent 
training regimen for while I was away. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah. Got it. I'll make sure to 
get it done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her reassurance, a lingering worry 
remained... Wondering how to keep her 
motivated even in my absence, an 
advertisement caught my eye.
choice_data_list:
With this, I might be able to get myself 
hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What what♡ Does that mean you're my 
personal puppy~!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, they're filling in for me while I'm 
away on a business trip.

Yeah, they're filling in for me while I'm 
away on a business trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I handed her was a rented monitoring 
robot. It came equipped with a remote 
camera and two-way calling features.
choice_data_list:
When it's time for training, I'll check 
with the robot.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yup! Okie-dokie! Since we're at it, 
maybe I should give it a name~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wan-wan? Wan-maru? —Yep! Wan-dora it is~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, when training time 
arrived, I operated the monitoring robot 
remotely from my business trip.
choice_data_list: Now then, how is Pandora doing...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Wando. Don't you feel kinda 
sluggish todayyy?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to take a break just for today, 
right? Besides, I deserve super mega props 
just for showing up at the track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora is trying to slack off. I 
turn on the call function to snap her out 
of it.
choice_data_list:
"No can do, your workout starts right 
now."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way?! The dog-dragon talked?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this little guy can talk?! Aha, so 
smaaaart☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she assumed a robot was talking 
since the voice changed over the 
microphone. Regardless, it seemed to have 
gotten her pumped up.
choice_data_list: (In that case, I might as well just...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Wan-dora. Why don't you add 'woof' to 
the end of your sentences? Come on, woof ♡
choice_data_list: "Understood, starting now-woof."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha♪ Okeeey~~♡ Watch me from right there♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wahaa~... That was a good run~~... Huh, 
what was the next workout again?
choice_data_list: "Gym Workout Ruff!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're gonna teach me? You're like, 
super smart~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Heave, ho... Haa, haahhh...!
choice_data_list: "Good job, you worked super hard, woof!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ You know it~! I feel like I was 
totally in the zone today~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for watching, Wandora♪ Who's a good 
boy? You are~~♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So cute~~♪ Is that little one yours, 
Pandora-san?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah! One-dra! She's looking over my menu!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This little guy is super smart~♪ Right, 
Wan-dora? ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah! There's dust on the wandorayaki!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Awwww, you're so helpless~♡ Before I put 
you back on your charger, I'll give you a 
nice brushing~♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days passed in this manner. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, welcome back~! Hey, hey, listen, 
listen!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I trained super hard! Together with 
Wan-dora!
choice_data_list: Way to go, Pandora!
Way to go, Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~♪ You're happy to get 
compliments too, right, Wandora~? Right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over these past few days, Fusaichi Pandora 
worked hard thanks to the robot. However, 
now that the business trip is over, the 
robot's role is finished too, and...
choice_data_list: Pandora, about that girl...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Give it... back...?
choice_data_list: Ah, unfortunately...
Yeah, it's a shame, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No no no nooo! I don't wanna give it 
baaaaack!!
choice_data_list:
Still, it's a rental, so we have to return 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I was able to do my best because she was 
there! And she cheered for me so much, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I've come to love it so much...!!
choice_data_list: Pandora...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her loneliness comes through painfully 
clear. However, smart as she is, she 
surely understands things cannot stay this 
way.
choice_data_list:
...If you cry that much, it'll make them 
sad too, you know?

Instead, let's get a matching set with Wan 
Dora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...! ...If you say that to me...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. But, just for now... can you 
hold me...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course.
Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Let's train again. Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she murmured that, Fusaichi Pandora's 
profile seemed to look just a little bit 
more grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: M-Matching...
choice_data_list:
In that case, you won't feel lonely even 
when we're apart, right?

In that case, you won't feel lonely even 
when we're apart, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That sports towel has the same pattern as 
Wandora! Could it be... for me?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I thought it'd feel like we trained 
together.

Yeah, I thought it'd feel like we were 
training together.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! It feels so fluffy, totally 
like Wandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Now I'm matching with Wandora~♪ 
Thank you, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And also... Thanks for being my Wandora 
back then, Trainer!
